BTC-USD.invalidation: Sustained ETF net inflows or daily close back above prior breakdown levels: short bias invalid. New low with expanding rv_ratio: long fades invalid.
BTC-USD.long_when: Only mean-reversion longs after flushes: r1h strongly negative, imbalance turning positive, spread normal.
BTC-USD.quality_notes: Quality 3 requires aligned imbalance + trend_z + calm spread.
BTC-USD.short_when: Trend-following shorts when trend_z < -1.5 and bounces fade on thinning bid depth.
BTC-USD.thesis: Regime trade, not value thesis: risk-off tape (record Nov-2026 ETF outflows, new cycle low ~55.1k on 2026-11-21), neutral funding, rallies driven by short covering.

ETH-USD.invalidation: ETH/BTC turning up with positive imbalance invalidates shorts.
ETH-USD.long_when: Same as BTC mean-reversion longs, only if BTC snapshot is not in crisis.
ETH-USD.quality_notes: Penalise quality when spread_bps > 3 or depth5_usd is thin.
ETH-USD.thesis: Higher-beta leg of the same risk-off regime (ETH ~1,670 late Nov 2026); trades as BTC beta.

HYPE-USD.invalidation: Buyback run-rate falls >40% month-over-month, perp DEX share falls below ~35%, or regulatory action against the venue.
HYPE-USD.long_when: Long only on pullbacks absorbed with positive imbalance, never into unlock dates (Nov 29, Dec 6 2026).
HYPE-USD.short_when: Short on unlock-week weakness with negative imbalance and widening spread.
HYPE-USD.thesis: Value accrual is real: ~99% of perp fees fund open-market buybacks (Castle Labs: $77.9M holder buybacks in 30d to 2026-11-24). Discounted ~37% from ~$98 ATH (2026-09-23).
